title: WorldVisionAI
tagline: Ask the future!!: an AI agent powered by real users and prediction markets.
description:
📌 Overview – What is WorldVisionAI?
WorldVisionAI is a future-predicting platform that combines a ✅ verified prediction market with a 🤖 AI chat agent.
Users can place bets on future events using World ID for identity verification, and interact with an AI agent that responds based on real-time crowd sentiment and prediction data.
This creates a 🔁 powerful feedback loop where user insights continuously improve the AI's ability to forecast the future.

❗️Problem – Current Challenges
🔍 Unreliable Forecasting Data
Existing prediction markets and AI forecasting services struggle to provide trustworthy insights due to anonymity, low user commitment, and noisy data.
⏳ AI Can't Truly Answer Questions About the Future
Most AI systems rely heavily on historical data and lack real-time input from actual human expectations or real-world sentiment.

💡 Opportunity – Market Potential
✅ High-Trust Forecasting Data
By using World ID to verify participants' identities, we can collect high-quality, personhood-verified prediction data with reduced noise and increased reliability.
🔁 A Self-Reinforcing Feedback Loop
As users place bets and express their expectations, the AI becomes smarter. The smarter the AI becomes, the more it guides future predictions—creating a powerful feedback ecosystem.

🛠️ Solution – Our Approach
World Vision AI combines two key features to redefine future forecasting:
🎯 Prediction Market
Users can bet on future events through a traditional prediction market mechanism.
With World ID, users gain access to free betting opportunities, allowing broader participation without financial risk.
Identity verification ensures fairness and maintains system integrity through proof of personhood.
🧠 AI Chat Agent
Users can interact with a conversational AI agent to ask questions about the future.
This AI draws on live data from prediction markets, offering insights based on real-time collective intelligence and evolving crowd sentiment.
✨ Together, these features create a reinforcing loop:
👥 User participation trains the AI → 🤖 The AI improves its predictions → 🔄 Smarter user forecasts → 🧠 Even better AI performance.
how_its_made:
This project integrates cutting-edge Web3 technologies to deliver a seamless and trustworthy prediction experience. Here's how each partner technology contributes to the overall system.

🌍 World
・We use Worldcoin’s Mini App with the Verify and Pay commands to deliver a seamless, mobile-like experience with iris-based user verification. 
・The app is deployed on World Chain, allowing verified users to participate in predictions for free and enabling smooth on-chain payments.

🔗 Curvegrid
・We use Curvegrid’s MultiBaas platform, specifically its Cloud Wallet and Transaction Manager (TXM), to securely and reliably record prediction data on-chain after payments are made via the World App.

🚀 Hyperlane
・We use Hyperlane to seamlessly bridge rewards from World Chain to Optimism when users win predictions. 
・This enables fast, secure cross-chain payouts on a widely adopted Layer 2 network.
